Someone asked for the punishment that was coming.
It is for the people who said no. No one can stop it.
It is from Allah, the Lord of the stairs to the sky.
The angels and Jibril go up to Him in a day that is fifty thousand years long.
So be patient, with a beautiful patience.
They think it is far away.
But We see it as near.
On the Day when the sky will be like hot, melted metal.
And the mountains will be like soft wool.
No friend will ask about his friend.
They will see each other. A bad person will wish he could give his children to save himself from the punishment of that Day.
And his wife and his brother.
And his family who gave him a home.
And everyone on earth, to save himself.
No way! It is a blazing Fire.
It pulls off the skin of the head.
It calls the one who turned his back and ran away.
And who gathered money and kept it.
Man was made to be restless.
When something bad touches him, he complains.
When something good touches him, he holds it back.
Except people who pray.
Those who keep up their prayers.
And those who have a right share in their money.
For the one who asks and the one who is in need.
And those who believe in the Day of Judgment.
And those who fear the punishment of their Lord.
The punishment of their Lord is not something to feel safe from.
And those who keep themselves away from wrong.
Except with their wives, for then they are not to blame.
But whoever wants more than that, they are the ones who go too far.
And those who keep what they are trusted with and keep their promises.
And those who stand by the truth when they speak.
And those who take care of their prayers.
These will be honored in gardens.
What is wrong with the people who said no, who stretch their necks toward you?
From the right and from the left, in groups?
Does each of them want to be taken into a Garden of joy?
No way! We made them from what they know.
I swear by the Lord of the east and the west that We are able.
To replace them with better people. Nothing can stop Us.
So leave them to play and talk nonsense until they meet their Day that was promised.
The Day when they come out of their graves in a hurry, like running to a goal.
Their eyes will be low and shame will cover them. This is the Day that they were promised.
